The licence text is in LICENSE at the repository root and is unchanged from 1.x. This release adds the audit log, removes the legacy exporter, and requires Python 3.11 or newer. ## Changelog - **2.0** (2026-09-14) audit log added; legacy exporter removed. - 1.9 (2026-06-02) exporter deprecated. - 1.8 (2026-03-11) first public release. ## Support Security reports go to the address in SECURITY.md. This page is the publisher's own record of the release and states only what the publisher published.

Entries are written from what a project published, and each one records when the index first saw it. ## widget | Field | Value | | --- | --- | | Latest version | 2.0 | | First seen | 2026-09-14 | | Declared licence | Apache-2.0 | | Changelog entry for 2.0 | recorded 2026-09-14 | | Previous version | 1.9 (2026-06-02) | The 2.0 entry carries a changelog recorded on 2026-09-14: the audit log was added and the legacy exporter was removed. The index does not verify the claims a project makes about itself. It records what was published, and when this index first saw it.
